method: GitHub REST API issue bodies and all accessible paginated issue-conversation comments; external linked pages/proofs/testcases were not fetched or executed. Source collection is not proof. Decisions are scoped to the retrieved motivating examples and selected discussion, not a claim to have exhaustively validated every comment.

reports.title: Optimizer doesn't eliminate select with two equivalent operands
reports.scope: Equivalence of select-of-add and add-of-select requires symbolic congruence across shared arithmetic, not merely same-condition arm elimination.

reports.title: Failure to optimize tautological comparisons of comparisons to a single one
reports.scope: Complementary comparisons are canonical zero/one values, not bitwise word complements. The word truth-table synthesizer cannot substitute NOT without a Boolean-only proof.

reports.title: [InstCombine] try to thread binop through select-of-constants
reports.scope: Threading a shift through a select needs proof that both per-arm shifts fold and all counts are valid. Variable operations are not cloned.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Failure to avoid decrement for non-zero input to comparison
reports.scope: Eliminating x-1 under x!=0 needs inequality/path nonzero intervals; a generic unsigned decrement wraps at zero.

reports.title: Remove !IsLogical conditions in foldAndOrOfICmps()
reports.scope: LLVM poison/freeze semantics differ from LCCC total eager integer operations. Removing IsLogical guards globally is not a local source rewrite.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Failure to merge similar comparisons that share a common true/false condition
reports.scope: Coalescing a Boolean comparison mux into x==select needs CFG/Boolean provenance and a target cost decision; no eager evaluation of short-circuit effects.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Failure to simplify nested selects
reports.scope: Reordering two independent select conditions requires decision-tree construction and sharing costs; direct same/inverse-condition substitution does not cover it.

reports.title: simplify logical selects
reports.scope: The motivating nested logical condition is composite, not the same predicate as its outer select; needs Boolean implication beyond the current local relation.

reports.title: Use three-operand LEA for select of constants on some x86 architectures
reports.scope: Three-input LEA formation is x86 microarchitecture and instruction-encoding policy, not a target-neutral scalar-select identity.

reports.title: `(-1 + b) & x` → `select b, 0, x` should work for `!range {0, 2}` too, not just for `i1`
reports.scope: LLVM load range {0,2} and i1 trunc semantics are not arbitrary scalar truthiness; no missing range metadata is fabricated.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Add of select and zext/sext of the select condition not simplified
reports.scope: Constant-choice scalar binop with a same-condition zero/one Boolean folds both constant outcomes; sext(i1) and cross-width signed-mask variants are not claimed.

reports.title: Select not sunk into branch on same condition
reports.scope: Sinking a shared select across branch/call boundaries needs CFG dominance and effect checks; local consumer substitution does not relocate definitions.

reports.title: Failure to fold comparison implication in and chain
reports.scope: Implication across several ordered comparisons needs a relational interval/constraint solver, not merely exact predicate complement matching.

reports.title: copysign of select derived from sign comparison can fold into sign operand
reports.scope: Floating copysign/select changes must preserve signed zero, NaNs and FP environment contracts; scalar integer substitution refuses FP carriers.

reports.title: [DAG] Failure to fold select(x, sub(x, c), m) -> sub(x, and(c,m))
reports.scope: The motivating vector blend/sub mask is target instruction selection; no vector-mask/all-ones policy is inferred from scalar zero/one Booleans.

reports.title: [InstCombine] `!(A & INT_MIN) && A & INT_MAX` is not folded to signed comparison with zero
reports.scope: The logical signbit/nonzero conjunction requires CFG/interval-to-signed-comparison formation and cannot be replaced by generic bitwise NOT.

reports.title: Simplification Comparison for `(a | b) ? (a ^ b) : (a & b)` etc. (Clang13 vs Clang trunk)
reports.scope: Boolean three-input select algebra needs a dedicated zero/one decision table; per-bit word algebra and arbitrary nonzero truthiness are not interchangeable.

reports.title: [InstCombine][EarlyCSE] Missed optimization for not canonicalizing `select uge/ult, A, B`
reports.scope: Select predicate canonicalization for cross-block CSE needs dominance-aware value numbering; flipping every predicate has no guaranteed target benefit.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Missing optimization: fold `mul (select a, b), (select b, a)` to `mul a, b`
reports.scope: Commutative Add/Mul/And/Or/Xor of symmetric correlated selects becomes the corresponding operation on the original arms, without mutating shared selects.

reports.title: Missing optimization: fold `k & c ? 0 : k & c1` to `k & !c ? 0 : c1` to remove bitmask in select arm
reports.scope: Changing short-circuit block layout requires verifying side effects and duplicating neither calls nor loads; no CFG transform is introduced.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Missing optimization: fold `select (a != V1 & a != V2), V1, a` to `select (a == V2), V2, V1`
reports.scope: The two-inequality condition needs disjunctive path facts; independent known bits cannot prove the selected value is always one of two symbolic values.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Missed optimization: fold `((select C1, C2) | A) ^ C3` to `(select C1^C3, C2^C3) | A)`
reports.scope: The original uses LLVM or-disjoint. Without explicit disjoint-bit proof, moving XOR through OR is false on overlapping bits.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Failure to fold (and %x, (sext i1 %m)) -> (select %m, %x, 0) with multiple uses of %m
reports.scope: The original vector sext masks are all-ones and shared; factoring across vector arithmetic needs mask provenance and target-cost checks.

reports.title: [InstCombine] fold select of select with common argument
reports.scope: Factoring independent predicates into a shared Boolean select is a decision-tree/cost rewrite, not same-condition leaf substitution.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Missed optimization: fold select if the user of its select user indicates the condition
reports.scope: Deep correlated decision trees would require rebuilding a shared intermediate select. No shared producer is mutated or cloned to force this reduction.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Missed optimization: fold chained selects with exclusive condition but one identical arm
reports.scope: The motivating result is a pointer. Scalar integer substitution deliberately does not invent pointer null/provenance semantics.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Missed optimization : fold `binop(select cond, C1, C2, zext(cond))`
reports.scope: Scalar constant-choice binop with its canonical Boolean predicate is evaluated per outcome; no variable operation or effect is cloned.

reports.title: [IPSCCP] Missed optimization: refine range of `select`
reports.scope: The report is interprocedural argument specialization and dead argument removal; local facts cannot substitute across arbitrary calls.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Missing fold for nested selects
reports.scope: Two independent composite Boolean predicates require decision-tree rebuilding with sharing costs; no unbounded BDD search is added.

reports.title: Failure to propogate knowledge from comparison into branches
reports.scope: The source contains undef on a PHI edge and a conditional load; preserving both edge semantics and non-speculation requires CFG/PHI work.

reports.title: trunc nuw x to i1 as branch/select cond implies x
reports.scope: trunc nuw to i1 relies on a no-wrap flag and i1 type semantics absent from LCCC scalar casts; arbitrary truncation does not imply x in {0,1}.

reports.title: [LLVM] Missed optimization on boolean instructions.
reports.scope: The motivating networks overlap the specialized mux/distributive policy protected after CH/MAJ regressions. A general smaller IR recipe is not automatically a better target shape.

reports.title: [instcombine] select of symmetric selects
reports.scope: Symmetric same-condition scalar selects with the same arm values are handled at commutative and Eq/Ne consumers; arbitrary decision-tree canonicalization is not included.

reports.title: Save a comparison when checking integer is within two disjoint ranges
reports.scope: Two disjoint interval unions require range-set costing; no convex-hull replacement is sound across the missing interior point.

reports.title: Regression in InstCombine Pass: Missing Simplification of icmp with Bitwise AND and llvm.assume Condition
reports.scope: The issue body only links external reductions. Those linked examples were not fetched; no implementation or equivalence is claimed from the title alone.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Regression in and of masked comparison fold
reports.scope: Equality-of-masked-parts needs consistent whole-word versus trunc-i1 canonicalization and Boolean observation proofs; per-bit NOT is not Boolean NOT.

reports.title: [ValueTracking] `icmp X, C1` implies `(and X, C2) != C3`
reports.scope: A lower-bound assumption implies a disjunction of high bits, not a fixed known-one bit. Independent known bits cannot represent it.

reports.title: Missed Optimization: Fold parity select (x&1 ? (x-1): (x|1) ) into x ^ 1
reports.scope: Parity-select arithmetic may fold to XOR only with matching mask, orientation and wrapping/overflow contracts; general subtraction factoring is not introduced here.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Missed icmp_ne(and(x,1),0) -> trunc(x) fold
reports.scope: LCCC has no scalar i1 truncation carrier. Emitting an ordinary integer trunc instead of a canonical comparison would change truth values.

reports.title: LLVM does not optimize (c & a) | (!c & b) into select %c, %a, %b
reports.scope: The mixed eager/logical Boolean mux must preserve zero/one canonicalization and specialized ANDN policy; it is not generic word-mask synthesis.

reports.title: InstCombine should fold shift of boolean zext to logic sequence
reports.scope: Shift of two zero/one extensions can fold only after a complete valid-count and Boolean provenance proof; noncanonical word conditions would be unsound.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Discuss generalizing icmp eq/ne X, 0 to trunc X to i1 using KnownBits
reports.scope: Known one-bit range is useful for facts but does not authorize a non-existent i1 trunc carrier. Keep canonical zero/one comparisons.

reports.title: Missed optimization: fold icmp eq (or (select A, 256, 0), zext B), 257 to and A, B
reports.scope: The motivating concatenated Boolean observation requires a bit-position/cardinality solver; FP comparison leaves stay opaque and no FP rewrite is claimed.

reports.title: missed optimization: fold fcmp une between two sign-extracting selects to xor
reports.scope: FP-select comparison elimination requires NaN and signed-zero-aware constant equality; this cohort admits only integer select carriers.

reports.title: [CVP] Missed vector select simplification for `select (icmp ult X, 1<<N), (and X, (1<<N)-1), K`
reports.scope: The motivating report is vector correlated propagation. The scalar control is exercised, but scalar range-arm simplification is not vector issue closure.

reports.title: [InstSimplify] Simplify same-condition select pair comparisons
reports.scope: Same-condition scalar-select comparisons with provably constant/equal-arm outcomes fold to a Boolean constant or choice. Arbitrary assume-based variable ordering is not modeled.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Fold `select (x == -1), y, umin(x, y)` to `umin(x, y)`
reports.scope: Unsigned min with all-ones sentinel needs a min/max-specific identity; signed min and non-sentinel constants are not generalized.

reports.title: [SE] Prove umin/umax comparisons before operand canonicalization
reports.scope: Min/max predicate ordering in the constraint solver is a distinct mechanism and vectorization proof; no intrinsic min/max representation is added.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Fold equality with self-dependent select to constant set membership
reports.scope: Self-dependent select equality to finite-set membership can expand one comparison into two; legality and target cost must both be justified.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Missed simplification through a shared select condition
reports.scope: The motivating pointer GEP/select requires pointer provenance and offset factoring; direct scalar same-condition nested selects are tested but do not close the pointer report.

reports.title: sse code spiller suboptimality (only 2 registers used for 280 instructions)
reports.scope: Allocator spill placement/register-pressure objective; requires executable reproduction of the old SSE graph and allocator evidence, not scalar identity rewriting.

reports.title: x86 codegen for long AddRec expansion could be improved
reports.scope: Loop AddRec strength reduction needs induction-variable legality, overflow and register-pressure costing; attached IL is not a local scalar contract.

reports.title: unnecessary moves between XMM and general registers by x86 back end
reports.scope: Cross-register-file value placement is backend/ABI policy; bitcast identities alone do not prove eliminating XMM/GPR moves is profitable.

reports.title: [x86 code size] Inefficient encoding of cmp/test with immediate argument and dead register
reports.scope: Immediate-compare encoding alternatives require dead-register and exact flags liveness proofs; do not replace comparisons by flag-different INC/DEC globally.

reports.title: missed bswap.
reports.scope: The original C++ byte-swapping loop requires memory/alias and loop recognition; the existing SSA byte network matcher does not close it.

reports.title: gcc tail merges cases that llvm doesn't
reports.scope: Machine tail merging is CFG/exception/layout work, not a consumer-local equality; old attached testcase needs a dedicated backend experiment.

reports.title: clang does not properly optimize xor expressions
reports.scope: Mixed-width XOR cancellation requires cast-aware demanded-bit reconstruction; no cast/shift movement is added to this consumer-local change.

reports.title: Combine and-mask+icmp eq -> icmp ule when mask was all-ones in high bits
reports.scope: Contiguous high OR-mask and low AND-mask equality against the original operand become a single unsigned bound; sparse masks refuse.

reports.title: redundant mask op could be eliminated
reports.scope: Store/truncation commoning requires cross-width dominance-aware CSE; retain both stores and all observable memory accesses.

reports.title: Missing opt with ctlz and shifts of power of 2 constants
reports.scope: Total CLZ of a shifted power-of-two must saturate at the width; an unconditional affine result is false after the bit shifts out.

reports.title: [InstCombine] and-mask + conditional "sext" -> and-mask + sext
reports.scope: Variable-width sign extension needs len bounds and exact signed shift semantics; len=0 and full-width lengths require separate cases.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Dropping pointless masking before right shift
reports.scope: Dynamic mask elimination before a shift must relate its count and demanded bits; arbitrary mask/count independence is insufficient.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Dropping pointless masking before left shift
reports.scope: The original six forms include truncation and count-sum constraints; no common blanket mask-elimination rule is valid.

reports.title: InstCombine combines mul->shift into two multiplies.
reports.scope: Multiply/rotate scheduling and target multiply-high selection need per-target costing; do not reassociate through truncation without proof.

reports.title: Failure to combine rotate through a select
reports.scope: Conditional rotate formation trades shared shifts against a rotate and select; existing target recognition is deliberately preserved, not replaced by generic select factoring.

reports.title: Failure to optimize compare and bitwise and with same operands properly (stuck at intermediate transformation)
reports.scope: The source returns a canonical Boolean, whereas ~x is a word mask; converting through CFG/bit-zero demand needs its own observation proof.

reports.title: Failure to optimize some related bool comparisons to xor+and
reports.scope: Short-circuit Boolean CFG factoring cannot speculate calls or loads. The eager bitwise counterpart is not a whole-report resolution.

reports.title: Failure to optimize simple bitwise pattern
reports.scope: Signed max/sub/mask reduction must preserve negative inputs and wrapping boundaries; unsigned modular-remainder recognition alone is insufficient.

reports.title: Optimize switch wirh icmp with and
reports.scope: Switch-domain/complement case coverage requires CFG successor and bitfield-range reasoning; local select substitution does not rewrite switches.

reports.title: Failed to combine popcount(x) +  popcount(x >> 32) to popcountl(x)
reports.scope: Two narrow popcounts to one wide count is legalization/target-cost work; software POPCNT fallback and cross-width result casts need independent evidence.

reports.title: Unrecognized rotate patterns
reports.scope: The motivating 32-bit word with 64-y shift counts has no common fully defined C shift domain; do not use poison to infer modular rotate semantics.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Missed optimization for icmp ult <power-of-2> & mask check
reports.scope: Conjunction of x < 2^k and a contiguous top-aligned mask != mask becomes x < mask; sparse, misaligned and missing-bound variants refuse.

reports.title: failed to fold shift amount offset into shift of a constant, part 2
reports.scope: Offset-shift reassociation requires a no-wrap count bound and exact/signed-shift contracts that are not represented by the current scalar matcher.

reports.title: Missed optimization: Bitwise shifts don't backpropagate knowledge about their operands
reports.scope: Rejected backward inference from shift poison/undefined behavior: a speculated poison-producing shift is not an unconditional path assumption.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Failure to recognise hidden xor
reports.scope: Zero observation of AND of identical disjoint nonzero constant-choice selects compares their canonical Boolean predicates; shared producers are retained.

reports.title: Weaken `xor` to `or` under `nand`
reports.scope: XOR to OR requires a dominating disjointness/NAND relation; for x=y=1 XOR=0 but OR=1. Known-one bits do not express arbitrary disjointness.

reports.title: Nan boxing misoptimization: missing icmp combine?
reports.scope: NaN-tag interval coalescing needs an unsigned interval union solver. Treating tag bits as floating-point values would be unsound.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Missing fold for 'and' pattern with multiple used 'xor'
reports.scope: LLVM sext(i1) is an all-ones mask, unlike LCCC zero/one Boolean casts. A mask-to-select rule needs explicit mask provenance and target costs.

reports.title: Transform 31 - CTLZ into CTLZ ^ 31 on x86
reports.scope: Rejected unconditional CLZ/XOR rewrite at zero. The total count zero result differs from the nonzero contract.

reports.title: Missed optimization for C ? BSWAP(X) : 0
reports.scope: The discussion reports a GCC correctness bug in collapsing a select/bswap shape; zero-handling and demanded-byte proofs are mandatory.

reports.title: Inconsistent behaviour between using logical and bitwise `and`/`or` on `smin`/`smax`
reports.scope: Signed min/max sign observations require correlated order predicates; the source repeats the smin body as smax, so its spelling cannot be treated as an independent proof.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Missing and of icmp fold
reports.scope: Explicit x != MAX guard plus wrapping x+1 <=u y becomes x <u y; no unguarded increment reassociation.

reports.title: Consider reducing 64-bit shifts with clamped shift amounts to 32-bit
reports.scope: Splitting 64-bit variable shifts into 32-bit halves is target legalization and code-size/latency work; quarter-rate target costs are not generic scalar costs.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Missed optimization for icmp(constants[x]) when the range of x is implied
reports.scope: Constant-global table load bounds require alias-aware memory and index-domain analysis; no load is evaluated or moved here.

reports.title: Comparison of add of extended booleans not folded to xor
reports.scope: Equality-to-one of the sum of two canonical zero/one Boolean extensions becomes XOR; negated/all-ones masks refuse.

reports.title: [InstructionSimplify] The result of icmp should be false.
reports.scope: Unsigned (x|z) < (x >> count) is false only with an explicitly proved valid count; unknown counts and signed predicates refuse.

reports.title: folds for icmp-of-sum-of-extended-i1 aren't happening in more complex code
reports.scope: The Rust tuple form relies on sext(i1)=-1 versus zext(i1)=1 and cross-width comparisons; zero/one Boolean cardinality is not a signed-mask solver.

reports.title: [instcombine] fold icmp eq/ne (min a, b), (max a, b) to icmp eq/ne a, b
reports.scope: Eq/Ne of symmetric same-condition scalar selects becomes Eq/Ne of their arms; intrinsic min/max and relational min/max predicates are not claimed.

reports.title: [SCCP][ConstantRange] Missed optimization due to approximation of `xor` operation on ConstantRange
reports.scope: CLZ/XOR value ranges need non-convex interval analysis, not independent per-bit facts. No accidental bounds are inferred from builtin C undefined zero.

reports.title: popcount 8-bit optimization opportunity (without HW instructions)
reports.scope: Software narrow popcount multiplication needs a target fallback cost model and exact truncation proof; native POPCNT is not replaced blindly.

reports.title: bit-count operation fallbacks can be optimized based on mask
reports.scope: Sparse-mask POPCNT/CTZ expansions require target latency and an explicit zero policy; hardware scan instructions are not globally expanded.

reports.title: target emission for ctlz doesn't account for range metadata
reports.scope: Narrow nonzero CLZ promotion is target legalization with load range metadata; this change does not invent metadata on arbitrary narrow loads.

reports.title: LLVM fails to optimize emulated arithmetic right shift down to a single ashr
reports.scope: Recovering AShr from sign-conditioned LShr/NOT requires common-count and signed-predicate correlation, beyond a same-condition leaf substitution.

reports.title: LLVM fails to optimize BitScanForward loop to a single cttz instruction
reports.scope: Scan-loop recognition needs PHI/exit/zero-case and count-range proofs; consumer-only rewrites intentionally do not edit loops.

reports.title: Multiply by a power of 2 and ctz+shift should often be interchangeable
reports.scope: Multiply-lowbit versus CTZ/shift is target dependent; y=0 forbids introducing a nonzero scan without an explicit guard.

reports.title: [ValueTracking] Missed optimization: Infer known bits from `a & mask == 0`
reports.scope: Nonzero observation of a power-of-two masked value supplies the known-one bit to the existing unique-predecessor facts engine; multi-bit masks do not imply individual known ones.

reports.title: Missed optimization: right shift (>>) with first operand up-cast to longer types
reports.scope: Cross-width right-shift comparison needs valid counts for both widths plus extension semantics; sign extension is not zero extension.

reports.title: Missed peephole opt: `sub nuw 15, x` => `xor x, 15`
reports.scope: Low-contiguous-mask minus x becomes XOR only when existing known bits prove x fits that mask; unbounded x and implicit LLVM nuw refuse.

reports.title: Bad codegen using `@llvm.ctlz.i8/i16`
reports.scope: Narrow leading-ones promotion needs baseline BSR/LZCNT legality and zero behavior; preserve current scan selection until target-specific evidence exists.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Optimize multiple compares using `xor`
reports.scope: Unicode XOR/sub interval coalescing is target-cost sensitive, including AArch64 conditional compare; no architecture-independent speed claim.

reports.title: Failure to optimize shift+compare pattern for sign check when done as a ternary as well as when using a computed goto
reports.scope: Scalar select-arm substitution removes addition of an explicitly zero false-arm value; constant-shift known bits can prove a nonzero top-bit extraction equals one. Computed-goto restructuring is not included.

reports.title: `-1 << (k + 1)` => `-2 << k` Inverted shift optimizations should incorporate offsets
reports.scope: Pre-shifting a constant requires count+1 to stay below width without wrapping; masked k alone is not sufficient at k=width-1.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Missed combines for `(icmp (udiv exact x1, y) (udiv exact x2, y))`
reports.scope: Exact paired divisions cannot cancel for arbitrary wrapping integers: distinct numerators may have the same quotient. Exactness/divisibility metadata is absent.

reports.title: x86 missed optimization for __builtin_clz()^31
reports.scope: CLZ XOR31 plus one crosses a narrowing cast and nonzero builtin contract; baseline BSR behavior at zero cannot be assumed defined.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Missed cttz nonzero fold through odd multiplication
reports.scope: Odd multiplication preserves CTZ/nonzero, but path nonzero facts for arbitrary words and scan legalization remain separate from bitwise known-one inference.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Generalise `bitreverse(bitreverse(x) << 1) => x >> 1` to more complex operations on `x`
reports.scope: General bitreverse conjugation across arithmetic/counts needs width and overflow-specific identities; the source includes more than the elementary opposite-shift case.
